fullPrompt: Recolor of the reference image, keep the exact same composition, shapes, angles and hand-drawn style. Minimal macOS app icon for ExcaliPPT: a marker pen whose silhouette doubles as a legendary sword (long pen body as blade, cap band as crossguard, nib sharpened as sword tip), drawn diagonally with one thick rounded swoosh stroke trailing from its tip. New color combination: solid pure white background (no gradient, no vignette); the pen-sword body drawn in deep violet-purple #6965DB with thick rounded hand-drawn Excalidraw-style strokes; the swoosh stroke from the nib in coral-red; keep tiny highlight details minimal. Only the pen-sword and one stroke, generous negative space, no text, no letters, no shadows, flat logo-grade vector illustration, thick confident strokes readable at 16 pixels, centered with generous margins, matte finish, 1024x1024, 1:1.
